state: ECEF position and separate per-observed-epoch/system receiver clocks in metres
input_role: corrected undifferenced raw pseudorange; raw-Doppler WLS velocity with preregistered graph covariance(0.6 m/s)^2 I
velocity_output_role: finite difference of optimized positions; not an additional graph state
window: all supplied sequence history; future observations used offline
c_gm_source: PDF p.7 applied parameters; whitened residual is dimensionless
weight_equation_source: Stationary minimizer of Eqs19-21, Algorithm1 Step3; recovers Eq18 GM surrogate
printed_eq22_ambiguity: Printed unsquared expression is not the Eq21 stationary solution. Optional EQ22_PRINTED_UNSQUARED_DIAGNOSTIC has a separate output identity and makes no GM auxiliary-minimum claim.
final_theta_policy: no clamp to one; no final alternation or extra state solve
output_weights_role: last Step3 weights; distinct from last Step2 state_solve_weights
zero_theta_policy: Zero total initial objective is returned as an explicitly labelled exact limiting solution; zero Eq23 theta with nonzero Doppler objective is undefined and unavailable, without an invented floor.
numerical_parameter_source: Engineering safeguards fixed before runs, common to all sequences; inner/budget failure remains failure
initialization: raw per-epoch WLS; raw-Doppler propagation only for missing initial guesses in an anchored connected component
missingness: missing/invalid Doppler covariance breaks the corresponding graph edge; no epoch deletion or fallback output
rank_policy: require 3D translation rank after clock elimination before/after weighting; no artificial prior
remaining_adaptations: independent implementation, not acquired author GNC solver
full-batch sparse Gauss-Newton/backtracking instead of a validated identical author numerical backend
paper state velocity notation not separately allocated where published factors constrain position differences
zero-theta exact limiting case is explicitly declared

Real Doppler graph sigma0.6 m/s comes from publicly available GraphGNSSLib denominator convention; the paper author GNC full numerical covariance settings were not acquired, WLS fit covariance is not silently substituted.
doppler_covariance_role: WLS fit covariance saved diagnostically; real graph uses the original preregistered isotropic0.6 m/s covariance. General factor implementation supports full covariance, but this real input is diagonal.
